expiry_rule: Resolve to an explicit UTC expiry when the owner accepts the final executable plan; do not start its clock during authoring. Never auto-renew.
cost_boundary: The $100 proposal is a shared agent-execution budget, not proof that direct Bedrock, workflow or infrastructure charges are metered by the engine. Probe/runtime request and duration limits must be enforced before calls. Confirm target pricing/cost ceiling in preflight.

roles.architect: Finalize criteria, capability matrix, fixtures and evidence contracts. Does not approve gates.
roles.codex-reviewer: Review exact PR head, repair findings, rerun required checks and complete authorized merge through the engine.
roles.engine: Own dependencies, dispatch, deployment verification, evidence settlement and visible blockers.
